Author: Serpens66
Name: Spectator
Description: Spectator perspectives, live statistics and local AI testing tools.

Changes: First release in the Serps Mods pack. Spectator features previously included in Bugfixes and QoL now live in this mod; existing perspective and post-elimination settings are transferred once.
Switch the displayed player, reports and ally view through the portrait bar as a spectator or an eliminated player with host permission.
Open detailed match statistics and the Lord overview during play; the host can allow extra enemy statistics for active players.
Optionally control the viewed player as a spectator from the start of a singleplayer skirmish. Off by default; the selected player's AI remains active.

Use optional AI test tools for buildings, units, goods, gold, orders, powers and gates. Spectator tools and active-player singleplayer test mode are both off by default and unavailable in real multiplayer and the map editor.
Keep the camera in place when placing test buildings for an AI lord. Eliminated spectators see the build menu read-only unless an allowed singleplayer test placement is active.
Credit gold immediately or add goods as storage space becomes available; debit removes stored and incoming reserves down to zero. Rejected amounts show the reason.
Edit the amount only by clicking its field. Enter and Esc finish editing without sending a credit or debit and return keyboard control to the game; an empty field becomes zero.
